recipes.name: Paneer Butter Masala (Home Style)
recipes.description: Soft paneer in a tomato-cashew gravy finished with butter and cream — weeknight restaurant-style at home.
recipes.notes: Original KitchenAI curated home version. Commercial-safe original text.

steps.title: Blanch base
steps.instruction: Simmer tomatoes, roughly chopped onion, and cashews in 1 cup water for 10 minutes until soft. Cool slightly, then blend smooth.

steps.title: Cook masala
steps.instruction: Heat oil and 1 tbsp butter. Add ginger-garlic paste; saute 30 seconds. Pour in the puree, chilli powder, salt, and sugar. Cook on medium until the oil separates and the gravy thickens, about 12 minutes.

steps.title: Finish gravy
steps.instruction: Stir in remaining butter, cream, garam masala, and crushed kasuri methi. Add a splash of water if too thick.

steps.title: Add paneer
steps.instruction: Cut paneer into cubes, slide into the gravy, and simmer gently 3–4 minutes. Do not boil hard. Rest 5 minutes before serving with roti or jeera rice.
steps.tip: Soak paneer in warm water 10 minutes for softer cubes.

recipes.name: Palak Paneer
recipes.description: Blanched spinach puree simmered with spices and soft paneer cubes — classic Punjabi green curry.

steps.title: Blanch spinach
steps.instruction: Wash spinach. Blanch in boiling water 2 minutes with a pinch of salt. Plunge into ice water, drain, and blend with green chilli to a smooth puree.

steps.title: Make tadka base
steps.instruction: Heat ghee. Crackling cumin, then saute finely chopped onion until golden. Add ginger, garlic, and chopped tomato; cook until soft.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.instruction: Add spinach puree and salt. Cook 8–10 minutes on medium, stirring. Loosen with a splash of water if needed.

steps.title: Paneer finish
steps.instruction: Add paneer cubes, garam masala, and cream. Simmer 3 minutes. Serve hot with roti or rice.

recipes.name: Punjabi Chole
recipes.description: Slow-simmered chickpeas in a dark, tangy onion-tomato masala — dhaba-style without meat stock.
recipes.notes: Soak chickpeas overnight. Original KitchenAI curated recipe.

ingredients.name: tea bag or loose black tea

steps.title: Cook chickpeas
steps.instruction: Pressure-cook soaked chickpeas with salt, tea bag, and enough water until soft (about 5–6 whistles). Discard tea. Reserve cooking liquid.

steps.title: Onion-tomato base
steps.instruction: Heat oil. Cumin first, then onions until deep golden. Add ginger-garlic paste and green chilli; saute. Add tomatoes and cook until mashy.

steps.title: Spice and simmer
steps.instruction: Add chole masala and cook 2 minutes. Add chickpeas with 1–1.5 cups cooking liquid. Mash a few beans for body. Simmer 15–20 minutes.

steps.title: Finish
steps.instruction: Stir in amchur and coriander. Rest 10 minutes. Serve with bhature, kulcha, or rice.

recipes.name: Rajma Masala
recipes.description: Creamy kidney-bean curry in a slow-cooked onion-tomato gravy — Sunday lunch staple of North India.
recipes.notes: Soak rajma overnight. Original KitchenAI curated recipe.

steps.title: Cook beans
steps.instruction: Pressure-cook soaked rajma with salt and water until very soft. Reserve liquid.

steps.title: Bhuno masala
steps.instruction: Heat oil. Cumin, then finely chopped onion until deep brown. Add ginger-garlic paste. Add tomatoes and powders; cook until oil leaves the sides.

steps.title: Combine
steps.instruction: Add rajma and enough cooking liquid for a thick gravy. Simmer 20–25 minutes, mashing a few beans.

steps.title: Finish
steps.instruction: Stir garam masala and coriander. Serve with steamed rice or jeera rice.

recipes.name: Aloo Gobi
recipes.description: Dry-ish potato and cauliflower stir-simmered with turmeric, cumin, and coriander — everyday North Indian sabzi.

steps.title: Prep veg
steps.instruction: Cut potatoes into medium cubes. Separate cauliflower into bite-size florets; rinse and drain well.

steps.title: Temper and saute
steps.instruction: Heat oil. Add cumin. Saute onion until translucent, then ginger. Add potato; cook 3 minutes. Add cauliflower, turmeric, chilli, coriander powder, and salt. Toss gently.

steps.title: Cover cook
steps.instruction: Add chopped tomato and 2–3 tbsp water. Cover and cook on low 12–15 minutes until tender, stirring once or twice.

steps.title: Finish
steps.instruction: Uncover to dry excess moisture. Garnish with coriander. Serve with roti and dal.

recipes.name: Dal Makhani (Home Style)
recipes.description: Black lentils and a few kidney beans slow-simmered, finished with butter and cream — vegetarian, no meat stock.
recipes.notes: Soak overnight. Original KitchenAI curated veg-leaning home version.

steps.title: Cook dals
steps.instruction: Pressure-cook soaked urad and rajma with salt and water until very soft and creamy (several whistles, then natural release).

steps.title: Tomato base
steps.instruction: In a heavy pot, heat oil and 1 tbsp butter. Saute ginger-garlic paste. Add tomato puree and chilli powder; cook until thick and glossy.

steps.title: Slow simmer
steps.instruction: Add cooked dals with cooking liquid. Simmer uncovered on low 45–60 minutes, stirring often and adding water as needed for a silky consistency.

steps.title: Finish
steps.instruction: Stir in remaining butter, cream, garam masala, and crushed kasuri methi. Rest 10 minutes. Serve with roti or rice.

recipes.name: Jeera Rice
recipes.description: Fluffy basmati tempered with cumin — the classic partner for dal, chole, and paneer curries.

steps.title: Rinse rice
steps.instruction: Rinse basmati until water runs clearer. Soak 15–20 minutes; drain.

steps.title: Temper
steps.instruction: Heat ghee. Add cumin, bay leaf, and cardamom until cumin crackles and smells nutty.

steps.title: Cook
steps.instruction: Add drained rice; toast 1 minute. Add water and salt. Bring to a boil, cover, and cook on lowest heat 12–14 minutes.

steps.title: Rest and fluff
steps.instruction: Rest covered 5 minutes. Fluff with a fork. Serve hot.

recipes.name: Soft Atta Roti
recipes.description: Everyday whole-wheat flatbreads rolled thin and cooked on a tawa until soft and lightly blistered.
recipes.notes: Roti technique notes as a full recipe. Original KitchenAI curated.

steps.title: Knead
steps.instruction: Mix atta and salt. Add water gradually and knead to a soft, smooth dough. Add oil, knead 1 minute more. Rest covered 15–20 minutes.

steps.title: Portion
steps.instruction: Divide into 10–12 balls. Dust with atta and roll each into a thin even circle.

steps.title: Cook first side
steps.instruction: Heat a tawa on medium-high. Place roti; cook until pale bubbles appear (about 30 seconds). Flip.

steps.title: Puff and finish
steps.instruction: Cook second side until brown spots form. Press gently with a cloth to help puff, or finish briefly over open flame if comfortable. Stack in a cloth to stay soft.
steps.tip: Dough should feel soft, not stiff — soft dough makes soft roti.

recipes.name: Matar Paneer
recipes.description: Peas and paneer in a lightly spiced tomato gravy — North Indian home comfort food.

steps.title: Base
steps.instruction: Heat oil. Cumin, then onion until soft-golden. Add ginger-garlic paste. Add chopped tomatoes, turmeric, coriander powder, and salt; cook until mushy.

steps.title: Peas
steps.instruction: Add peas and 3/4 cup water. Cover and simmer until peas are tender.

steps.title: Paneer
steps.instruction: Add paneer cubes and garam masala. Simmer 3–4 minutes. Garnish with coriander.

recipes.name: Bhindi Do Pyaza
recipes.description: Okra cooked with a double hit of onion until dry and lightly spiced — no sliminess if cooked uncovered.

steps.title: Prep okra
steps.instruction: Wash and thoroughly dry okra. Trim and cut into 2–3 cm pieces. Slice onions thickly.

steps.title: Fry okra
steps.instruction: Heat 2 tbsp oil. Saute okra on medium-high, stirring, until edges brown and slime cooks off, about 10 minutes. Remove.

steps.title: Onion and spice
steps.instruction: Add remaining oil. Cumin, then onions until soft with light colour. Return okra; add powders and salt. Cook uncovered 5–7 minutes.

steps.title: Finish
steps.instruction: Sprinkle amchur, toss, and serve with dal-roti.

recipes.name: Punjabi Kadhi Pakora
recipes.description: Tangy yogurt-besan gravy simmered with onion fritters — North Indian comfort with rice.

ingredients.name: besan (gram flour)
ingredients.notes: half for kadhi, half for pakora

steps.title: Pakora batter
steps.instruction: Mix half the besan with grated onion, pinch of salt, chilli powder, and enough water for a thick batter. Deep-fry spoonfuls until golden. Drain.

steps.title: Kadhi mix
steps.instruction: Whisk yogurt with remaining besan, turmeric, salt, and water until lump-free.

steps.title: Simmer kadhi
steps.instruction: Pour into a pot; bring to a gentle boil while stirring. Simmer 20–25 minutes until it thickens and loses raw besan taste.

steps.title: Temper and combine
steps.instruction: Heat 1 tbsp oil. Mustard, cumin, dried chilli, curry leaves, and ginger. Pour over kadhi. Add pakoras 5 minutes before serving so they soften but hold shape.

recipes.name: Malai Kofta (Vegetarian)
recipes.description: Paneer-potato dumplings in a mild cashew-tomato cream gravy — celebration dish, home-kitchen scale.
recipes.notes: Original KitchenAI curated recipe. Use cornstarch instead of flour for GF.

steps.title: Kofta mix
steps.instruction: Mash paneer and potato. Mix with cornflour, salt, and optional raisins. Shape into balls. Fry on medium until golden; drain.

steps.title: Gravy
steps.instruction: Saute onion in butter/oil until soft. Add ginger-garlic paste, then tomatoes and cashews; cook soft. Blend smooth with a little water.

steps.title: Cook gravy
steps.instruction: Return puree to pan with chilli powder and salt. Simmer until thick. Finish with cream and garam masala.

steps.title: Serve
steps.instruction: Warm gravy, add koftas just before serving so they stay intact. Pair with naan or jeera rice.

recipes.name: Shahi Paneer
recipes.description: Mild Mughlai-leaning paneer curry with yogurt, cream, and warm whole spices — richer and less tangy than butter masala.

steps.title: Onion paste
steps.instruction: Boil chopped onion and cashews until soft; blend smooth.

steps.title: Whole spices
steps.instruction: Heat ghee. Add bay leaf and cardamom. Saute ginger-garlic paste, then onion-cashew paste until light golden and oil shows.

steps.title: Yogurt
steps.instruction: Lower heat. Whisk in beaten yogurt gradually so it does not split. Add salt, pepper/chilli, and a little water; simmer 8 minutes.

steps.title: Finish
steps.instruction: Add paneer, cream, garam masala, and optional saffron milk. Warm through gently. Serve with naan or roti.

recipes.name: Baingan Bharta
recipes.description: Fire-roasted eggplant mashed into a smoky onion-tomato masala — Punjabi winter favourite.
recipes.notes: Original KitchenAI curated recipe. Oven-roast if open flame is unavailable.

steps.title: Roast eggplant
steps.instruction: Prick eggplants. Roast over flame or under broiler until skin chars and flesh collapses. Cool, peel, and mash.

steps.title: Masala
steps.instruction: Heat oil. Cumin, then onion until golden. Add ginger, garlic, and green chilli. Add tomato and chilli powder; cook until soft.

steps.title: Combine
steps.instruction: Add mashed eggplant and salt. Cook on medium 10–12 minutes, stirring, until thick and smoky aroma deepens.

steps.title: Finish
steps.instruction: Garnish with coriander. Serve with roti or paratha.

recipes.name: Aloo Paratha
recipes.description: Whole-wheat flatbreads stuffed with spiced mashed potato — North Indian breakfast classic.
recipes.notes: Ghee optional for vegan oil finish. Original KitchenAI curated recipe.

steps.title: Dough and filling
steps.instruction: Knead soft atta dough; rest 15 minutes. Mash potatoes with chopped chilli, coriander, spices, and salt. Cool filling completely.

steps.title: Stuff
steps.instruction: Roll a dough ball into a small disc, place filling in centre, seal, and roll gently into a thick circle.

steps.title: Cook
steps.instruction: Cook on a hot tawa. Flip when brown spots appear; brush both sides with ghee/oil until cooked through and crisp at edges.

steps.title: Serve
steps.instruction: Serve hot with yogurt, pickle, or butter.

recipes.name: Paneer Bhurji
recipes.description: Crumbled paneer quickly sauteed with onion, tomato, and green chilli — ready in under 20 minutes.

steps.title: Crumble
steps.instruction: Crumble paneer by hand into uneven bits.

steps.title: Saute base
steps.instruction: Heat oil. Cumin, then onion until soft. Add chilli, tomato, turmeric, and salt; cook until tomato softens.

steps.title: Add paneer
steps.instruction: Add paneer and garam masala. Toss 3–4 minutes on medium — do not dry it out.

steps.title: Finish
steps.instruction: Scatter coriander. Serve with roti, pav, or toast.

recipes.name: Yellow Dal Tadka
recipes.description: Everyday toor or moong dal finished with a sizzling ghee tempering of cumin, garlic, and chilli.
recipes.notes: Use oil instead of ghee for vegan. Original KitchenAI curated recipe.

steps.title: Cook dal
steps.instruction: Rinse dal. Pressure-cook with turmeric, salt, tomato, and water until soft. Whisk to a pourable consistency.

steps.title: Temper
steps.instruction: Heat ghee. Add cumin, asafoetida, sliced garlic, and dried chilli until garlic turns golden.

steps.title: Combine
steps.instruction: Pour tempering over dal. Simmer 3 minutes. Garnish with coriander. Serve with rice or roti.

recipes.name: Cucumber Raita
recipes.description: Cool yogurt side with grated cucumber, roasted cumin, and a pinch of chaat masala.

steps.title: Prep cucumber
steps.instruction: Grate cucumber. Squeeze lightly to remove excess water if very watery.

steps.title: Whisk
steps.instruction: Whisk yogurt smooth. Fold in cucumber, spices, salt, herbs, and optional chilli.

steps.title: Chill
steps.instruction: Rest 10 minutes in the fridge. Serve with biryani, pulao, or paratha.

recipes.name: Gajar Matar Sabzi
recipes.description: Winter carrots and peas cooked lightly with cumin and coriander — simple North Indian dry sabzi.

steps.title: Cut
steps.instruction: Dice carrots into small cubes.

steps.title: Temper
steps.instruction: Heat oil. Cumin and slit chilli. Add carrot, peas, turmeric, coriander powder, and salt. Toss.

steps.title: Cover cook
steps.instruction: Add 2 tbsp water, cover, and cook on low until carrots are tender but not mushy, about 12–15 minutes.

steps.title: Finish
steps.instruction: Sprinkle amchur, toss dry, and serve with roti and dal.

recipes.name: Vegetable Pulao
recipes.description: One-pot basmati with mixed vegetables and whole spices — lighter than biryani, weeknight-friendly.

steps.title: Prep rice
steps.instruction: Rinse and soak rice 15 minutes; drain.

steps.title: Saute
steps.instruction: Heat ghee. Whole spices and cumin. Saute onion until light gold. Add ginger-garlic and vegetables; cook 3 minutes.

steps.title: Rice
steps.instruction: Add rice; toast 1 minute. Add water and salt. Boil, then cover on low 12–14 minutes.

steps.title: Rest
steps.instruction: Rest 5 minutes. Fluff and serve with raita.

recipes.name: Aloo Methi
recipes.description: Potatoes cooked with fresh fenugreek leaves until the greens wilt and turn fragrant — slightly bitter, deeply savoury.

steps.title: Prep methi
steps.instruction: Pluck methi leaves, wash well, drain. Chop roughly. Cube potatoes.

steps.title: Cook potato
steps.instruction: Heat oil. Cumin and sliced garlic. Add potato, turmeric, chilli, coriander powder, and salt. Cover and cook until nearly tender.

steps.title: Add methi
steps.instruction: Add methi; cook uncovered on medium until leaves wilt and moisture dries, 6–8 minutes.

steps.title: Serve
steps.instruction: Taste for salt. Serve with roti and dal or kadhi.

recipes.name: Navratan Korma
recipes.description: Mild creamy vegetable curry with nine treasure-style mix-ins — nuts, paneer, and seasonal veg in a yogurt-cashew base.

steps.title: Prep
steps.instruction: Parboil firm vegetables until just tender. Soak cashews in warm water 10 minutes; blend with a little water to a paste.

steps.title: Base
steps.instruction: Heat ghee. Cardamom, then onion until soft. Add ginger-garlic paste. Stir in cashew paste; cook 2 minutes.

steps.title: Gravy
steps.instruction: Lower heat; add beaten yogurt, salt, and white pepper. Simmer gently. Add cream and a splash of water for a pourable gravy.

steps.title: Assemble
steps.instruction: Fold in vegetables, paneer cubes, raisins, and garam masala. Warm 3–4 minutes. Serve with naan or pulao.
